title: Nā ʻUhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola
explanation:
# Two-Sentence Summary

Two spiral galaxies 200 million light-years away are locked in a cosmic dance of collision and merger, their swirling arms intertwining as gravity pulls them inexorably together. This spectacular crash will ignite a tremendous burst of new star birth, forging the chemical elements—carbon, nitrogen, oxygen—that are essential ingredients for life itself.
